newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Valores cuts pricing on $155 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Valores cuts pricing on $155 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct (LPC) - Mexican holding company Valores Industriales SA (VISA) is taking advantage of liquidity in the Mexican loan market by slashing pricing on a $240 million credit put in place last year, according to banking sources.

The company has tapped J.P. Morgan & Co Inc, Citibank, Swiss Bank Corp and ING Barings for a $155 million, two-year loan that is priced at 375 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR) for the first year, 400 basis points over LIBOR for the second year, bankers said.
Lenders earn 37.5 bps upfront, bankers added.
The earlier deal, also two years, was priced at 500 basis points over LIBOR in year one, stepping up to 600 basis points over LIBOR in year two, a banker said.
